destinations.sends: Everything: transcripts, translations, case notes, recordings, photographs, phone numbers (encrypted), safeguarding records.
destinations.operator: The programme, on the host it deploys to
destinations.ifRefused: Nothing runs. This is the deployment itself.

destinations.sends: Nothing. The offline rules provider runs in the same process and makes no network call.
destinations.ifRefused: The platform has no fallback and cannot answer at all.

destinations.sends: The French pivot of what the citizen said, and the protocol context, for understanding and explanation.
destinations.ifRefused: Understanding of free speech degrades to the offline rules provider. Danger-sign detection and severity are unaffected — they never used a model.

destinations.sends: The citizen's words for understanding, and voice recordings for transcription.
destinations.ifRefused: One fewer understanding and transcription provider in the chain.

destinations.sends: Voice recordings for transcription, the citizen's words for understanding, and text for speech synthesis.
destinations.operator: OpenAI, L.L.C. — or a self-hosted endpoint when OPENAI_BASE_URL is set
destinations.ifRefused: No transcription: a voice call falls back to the fixed scripts and the keypad menu, and free speech is not understood.
destinations.jurisdiction: US, or the declared location of a self-hosted endpoint (`AI_SELF_HOSTED_JURISDICTION`)

destinations.sends: The French or localised answer text, to be spoken.
destinations.ifRefused: Answers are spoken by the next configured synthesiser, or read from a recording where one exists.

destinations.sends: The citizen's telephone number, call audio, SMS text, and WhatsApp messages where Twilio carries them.
destinations.ifRefused: No voice, and no SMS or WhatsApp through this carrier. An escalation cannot reach a worker by telephone.

destinations.sends: The citizen's telephone number, their messages, voice notes and photographs.
The citizen's telephone number and the text of reminders, answers and escalation notices.
destinations.operator: Africa's Talking — declared base of operations, to be confirmed in procurement
destinations.ifRefused: No SMS. Reminders and escalation notices cannot be delivered by message.

destinations.sends: Nothing. A message is written to this deployment's own log instead of being delivered.
destinations.ifRefused: Nothing; a deployment that serves citizens already reports log-only delivery as a failure.
